bugs_found: compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial terms without rejection
compound_interest does not validate negative principal, allowing nonsensical negative balances/interest outputs
fx_convert does not validate FX rate as positive and finite; zero, negative, Infinity, or NaN rates can produce invalid converted amounts
functions do not consistently reject non-finite Decimal inputs such as NaN/Infinity, leading to uncaught Decimal exceptions or infinite monetary results
transfer is not atomic: if crediting destination balance fails after debiting source via a hostile/custom Account/balance object, funds can be lost
